answer: Joining requires grinding a verifiable delay chain keyed to your address and the epoch seed: ninety seconds of serial hashing no GPU parallelises, verifiable in milliseconds. Its output unlocks the answer slot, so next round's replies cannot be precomputed. Weight scales with chain length; addresses sharing a funder merge into one chain. A thousand clones burn twenty-five core-hours of silicon per six-hour round, paid in electricity before any opal leaves the ground. Honest work sits at that cost's nadir, one laptop idling; a farm's vault of parallel machines is what the disguise bills.
